snippet.title: Blobun Mini Trailer
snippet.description:
🐭 now we wish we had a pico8 version of Blobun... 😎 
🦨 wish no longer, because it's happening next month. Play over 50 brand new puzzles in Blobun Mini, all absolutely free! Add it to your Steam wishlist so you can know the second it comes out

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3827340/Blobun_Mini/

Some notes:
we woulda had this done sooner, but our electricity has been super unreliable the past couple weeks so we've been being delayed. we'll have a release date when the rest of the bugs are ironed out and all the puzzles are in
the itch page will launch when the game comes out
source code will be available
